sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Visible under the right side of the optic's body, the inscription only reads "ACOG4X32", while the real-life counterpart features the inscription "ACOG4X32JN8:12", JN8:12 references the biblical verse John 8:12
"When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life."
